title: the serving engine comparison, ready for the bench host

findings.claim: the second serving engine's image is in no signed bundle and not in deploy/images.lock, by design until the bench shows it is worth shipping (the ruling 7122790579): the profile is bench and test boxes only, its image named by digest only, and the lock check refuses it anywhere else

nothing of the second engine's real behaviour is proven: its start with this command line, the served name, structured output, the candidates' 4-bit formats, memory sizing, chat template parity and every timing wait for the walk on the bench host

E2-9 has no code on master or in any pull request: the harness counts (patient, criterion) answers that differ between runs of the same input with tools.run_metrics.lists_compare, and reports them in the walk's form of 7117120038 (differences from run 1, per run and per criterion)
findings.state: not a defect: the integrator's ruling 7122790579 (2): lists_compare counts what E2-9 counted

findings.claim: R1-P2's instrumentation (tools/chart_times.py) is PR #1451, not on master: the per-chart time here has R1-P2's definition (the sum of a chart's own calls) but is measured at the client calling the engine, not through the gateway's audit

the vendor's release container licence was not read (its registry asked for a sign-in); the engine's source is Apache-2.0 and its installable package names a vendor licence agreement and a proprietary runtime component: the walk reads the container's licence before loading it
the second engine's /metrics is not in the metrics text form the current engine's is (per its source): R1-P2's queue, prefill and decode split would be not reported for it

the GPU memory peak is the whole card's used memory as the GPU monitor reports it, both servers and anything else on it; on a card split into partitions what it reports per partition is not known here

compose and check-image find the second engine's image by its repository digest; an image store that keeps no repository digest for a loaded file (the classic store, as make_bundle.sh notes) would refuse it on the bench host
the external review's 1459-1: the second engine ran from a local tag and no run output recorded the digest; now by digest only, never tagged or pulled, and every run records --image-digest
1459-2: a settings file saying second was read as off when unreadable, saved with a byte order mark or written with export: now refused or read as compose reads it
1459-3: doctor's bench_serving said PASS while the switch ran the second engine (it read only COMPOSE_FILE): it now reads the switch, and an unreadable switch counts as on

1459-4: the second profile dropped the judge's pinned chat template and the verifier's thinking off: the switch now refuses a judge template other than the current engine's, the verifier takes a thinking-off template, and the page maps each current flag

1459-5: the model servers' key file was handed to the second engine, which checks no key of its own, and VALIDATION boxes were allowed: env_file is reset on both servers and the switch is for TEST boxes only
1459-6: repeat agreement was not in the walk's form of 7117120038: now differences from run 1 per run and per criterion
1459-7: the bench mark was found only as an exact line: now as compose reads it, in doctor and images_lock
1459-8: a group- or world-readable settings file or key file was accepted: both must be mode 600
1459-9: the settings file was checked, then read again by compose: now read once, compose gets a private copy of the checked values, and deploy/site must be root's or the user's alone
1459-10: summary.json was written in place and a reused --out kept an earlier run's summary: now written whole, removed at a run's start, and table refuses a folder without a whole summary
1459-11: with --key-file the key goes over plain http to a non-loopback endpoint: left open, the bench reaches model-guard over the internal model network in plain http, as R1-P2's harness does
